metadata.description: Three small Claude Code mods: hide .env values from tool results, watch a remote box's memory, and measure a Markdown draft.

plugins.name: secret-guard
plugins.description: Hides your project's .env values from tool results before Claude reads them

plugins.name: spark-band
plugins.description: A band above the prompt with a remote Linux box's free memory, GPU processes and load, read over ssh

plugins.name: article-meter
plugins.description: A pane with your Markdown draft's words per numbered part, one part's share and the placeholders left, kept current as Claude edits it
